caption: The drawing consists of three outlined diagrams of an object labeled as an "Epaulete Box," presented on an off-white or cream background. The first diagram at the top is labeled "Isometric View" and shows a three-dimensional perspective of the box, featuring an oblong shape with rounded and straight edges as well as corner notches and raised rectangular sections. Below this is a "Top View," which provides an overhead outline of the box, showing its overall symmetrical form with curved sides, straight edge protrusions at cardinal points, and a small rectangular section in the center. The third diagram at the bottom, labeled "Side View," displays a rectangular shape divided into vertical sections, with lines that likely indicate the edges or joints of the box. All lines and labels are drawn in black ink. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner: "H. B. FREEMAN, JAN. 27, 1936."
title: Powder Box
